config.name: 主体内离焦约束 / 主体清晰保护 V2
config.purpose: Fixed diagnostic strategy, not depth correction or Ours. Q1 subject defocus distribution vs existing local detail observations; Q2 one tau across exploration sources and normal controls.

samples.role: highest eligible input-statistic rank4; no output inspected before selection

config.rule: Each frame on ORIGINAL grid, d=q/255 float64; inside original DAVIS ID!=0 union clamp d to[focus-tau/K,focus+tau/K], outside unchanged. Convert resulting q-scale float to native FP32 and use exact original author abs->bilinear antialias Resize->CenterCrop->Normalize. No PNG re-quantization. Transplant CoC only. Original MPI remains from original q.
config.failure_policy: Apply all25 frames, no per-frame skip, area limit, morphology, smoothing or hysteresis; no tau search or case-specific choice. Invalid input stops with evidence. Tiny FP32 deviations around exact mathematical cap are reported, not hidden by retuning.
config.mask_permission: DAVIS GT target union now supplies per-pixel CoC constraints beyond its baseline role in computing focus scalar. Generator does not receive mask/alpha directly. Not predicted-mask deployment.
config.multi_instance: Use entire union without choosing an easier ID. Per-ID statistics and outputs separate; may flatten genuine subject/object depth. Train4IDs and stroller2IDs disclosed.
config.execution: Original author f7a16959, original FP16/native VAE FP32 upcast; load seed0; restore legacy saved scene-entry CPU/CUDA state, CPU generator0 per call; original8-frame windows/4overlap/8-8-9 outputs, padding and caches. Independent clean process per scene/condition. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, serial GPU.
config.RNG_metadata_scope: Restore existing scene-boundary RNG metadata only, even when preceding legacy scene belongs to held-out split; never inspect that video's inputs, predictions or metrics.
config.A_policy: First rerun full25 B18 A and compare all RGB8 bytes to frozen DAVIS PNGs (legacy has no float arrays). Equal: others reuse frozen A; B18 probe reused, B36 current paired A reused. Unequal: all6 have current-environment A, reusing B18 probe and already-current B36 A as explicitly authorized, rerunning other4; preserve/report legacy mismatch. No unnecessary B36 rerun.
config.region_policy: Freeze masks BEFORE predictions: for each original nonzero ID AND independent union, nearest native limited-pixel mask intersect nearest ID display mask; remainder=ID minus limited. Exterior ring distance>=2 and<=6 display pixels from each ID/union, exclude ALL union foreground. Far background=distance>32 from UNION, same support shared across IDs (not independent repetitions). Euclidean precise distance; no intervention morphology. All A/V2 share exactly the same masks. B36 adds existing R2 input-defined target_head mask, held common for A/R2/V2, separate from full subject.
config.metrics: RGB8 MAE vs cv2.INTER_LINEAR projected original RGB (same prior CPU diagnostic convention), full-image Sobel3x3 energy ratio on3x3-eroded support. RGB8 V2-A mean/max channel difference, counts; ring/background peak coordinates ties row-major. Float comparisons only if a real current A float exists; no PNG/255 surrogate float. Empty support null. Adjacent frame differences use pair mask union, no motion compensation: region change, not flicker.
config.B36_R2_comparison: On common input-defined R2 head target, report A/R2/V2 MAE and edge ratio each frame; descriptive gap-fill fractions=(MAE_A-MAE_V2)/(MAE_A-MAE_R2) and(edge_V2-edge_A)/(edge_R2-edge_A), null if abs denominator<=1e-12, never clipped. These are input-relative numeric gaps, not recovered perceptual quality percentages.
config.stop: 统计与配对推理完成，等待用户视觉复核。Only six exploration sources; no held-out, training, PPT/talk/formal-table edits.

inference.A_policy: All six use current-environment A: B18 probe reused, B36 already-current paired A reused as explicitly required; other four A rerun.

A_reproduction.policy: All six use current-environment A: B18 probe reused, B36 already-current paired A reused as explicitly required; other four A rerun.

B36_gap_description: Unclipped input-relative MAE/gradient gap filling against R2, not a perceptual-quality recovery percentage.
cap_precision_note: Native mathematical cap1 holds. Strict>1 fractions retained. Nearest-projected display interior can still include native outside-union filter support; input-only linear contribution audit documents maximal points. Small FP32 excess is separately visible in native_FP32_inside_max. No grid interchange or threshold tuning.
limitations: Only6 exploration sources; no held-out videos or new neural metrics.
DAVIS GT union provides extra spatial condition permission beyond scalar focus, not predicted-mask deployment.
V2 is subject clear-protection, not depth correction or Ours. Multi-ID union can flatten genuine depth.
Closer to input RGB may just mean less defocus. Five human criteria remain separately pending.
Temporal regions are uncompensated pair unions, not flicker. Shared far-background repeated across IDs is not independent evidence.

input_mixing_audit.scope: Post-hoc input-only linear-resize contribution at per-source maximal interior point. No ROI/ranking/threshold/condition/output change; not an anatomical or true-depth verdict.
